LIGHTNING TALK

The change in Robotics through AI

Khadeja Anwar

Programming and Training

Before Engineers coded every movement. Great at one repetitive job, lost in anything messy or new. Now AI models learn from recorded demonstrations, the way chatbots learn from text and adapt to new objects. AI has transformed robots from machines that follow fixed instructions into machines that learn from examples.

Where does the data come from?

Chatbots learned from the whole internet. There's no internet of robot movements, so companies are building one. Training facilities Apptronik opened a dedicated data-collection and training center in Austin. Data marketplaces Kinectic Block sells first-person video and teleoperation recordings. AI Models The AI model used to teach robots is vision language action (VLA) models. Pi0, from Physical Intelligence, GR00T, from NVIDIA and RT-2, from Google DeepMind.
